title: Add '// keepAlive:' justification comments to the 8 bare keepAlive:true providers in preference_providers.dart
rule: SM-6 (every keepAlive: true carries an inline justification comment)
why: docs/coding-standards.md:154 requires 'every keepAlive: true carries an inline // keepAlive: justification'; the tagged-comment convention is already established elsewhere in this codebase (core/sync/providers/sync_orchestrator_providers.dart:51, features/profiles/.../pin_flow_controller.dart:127, features/content_browsing/.../content_providers.dart:12) but 8 of this file's 11 keepAlive sites carry zero comment of any kind, and even the one that does explain itself (hebrewTermsPreference, line 19-20) doesn't use the tagged format — so a future SM-6 audit grep has nothing to anchor on here.
recommendation: Add a one-line '// keepAlive: <reason>' above each, e.g. '// keepAlive: profile-scoped singleton preference store; lives for the app session.'
acceptance_criteria: A grep for 'keepAlive: true' in this file with no '// keepAlive' comment within 2 lines above returns zero hits (the SM-6 pending audit check).

corrections: 'the one that does explain itself' should be 'three' (lines 19-20, 77-79, 186-190 all have doc comments); doesn't change the 8 flagged sites.
